description: The bar chart illustrates module-level computational cost (in Giga-FLOPs) for different components across three “Audio back-end Conformer Stage” categories. The horizontal axis contains the stage categories in left-to-right order: “Stage 1 (d=180, n=500),” “Stage 2 (d=256, n=250),” and “Stage 3 (d=360, n=125).” The vertical axis is labeled “Module Giga-FLOPs” and uses a linear scale from 0 to 0.3 with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.1 intervals. Each stage shows a grouped set of four vertical bars: a blue bar (unlabeled in the legend) at approximately 0.28 for Stage 1, 0.16 for Stage 2, and 0.12 for Stage 3; a red bar labeled “grouped attention (g=3)” at about 0.155 (Stage 1), 0.12 (Stage 2), and 0.105 (Stage 3); a yellow bar labeled “patch attention (k=3)” at about 0.115 (Stage 1), 0.105 (Stage 2), and 0.10 (Stage 3); and a green bar labeled “feed-forward” at about 0.13 (Stage 1), 0.13 (Stage 2), and 0.13 (Stage 3). The bars are arranged side-by-side within each stage group (not stacked), there are no visible error bars or annotations on individual bars, and the stage categories appear in sequential stage order rather than being sorted by bar height.
